Onion Chives Pan Cake
By: ruteegee
Published: Wednesday, August 25, 2010 - 9:01pm

Ingredients




2 cups flour
1 cup water
2 medium eggs
1/2 teaspoon salt
3 teaspoons baking powder
1 tablespoon oil
1/4 cup fresh onion chives, cut into 1cm long

Preparation

1 Place all wet ingredients, salt and sugar in a bowl and beat well until sugar is completely dissoved. 2 Blend in flour and beat again to smooth consistency and add baking powder. do not over beat the batter. 3 Then add onion chives and fry it in a Teflon pan.
